liveProductionVerification.rationale: PostgREST anon key cannot access internal pg_catalog or supabase_migrations. Privileged service-role key is required to query applied migrations directly.

countingDefinitions.mobileRouteFiles: Total application route files in apps/mobile/app/ (all 53 files have .tsx extension, comprising 2 layout files and 51 route screen components).
countingDefinitions.mobileStores: Count of store files in apps/mobile/stores/ (*.ts).
countingDefinitions.apiRouteModules: Count of TypeScript route files in apps/api/src/routes/ (*.ts).
countingDefinitions.staticHttpRouteRegistrations: Count of static HTTP method registrations in route modules and server.ts matching app/fastify.<method>(...). Note: this is a static source inventory, not a live production endpoint count.
countingDefinitions.migrationFilesPresent: Count of .sql files present in supabase/migrations/ (exact count 36, numbered 001-034 plus out-of-order 0035 and duplicated 023). Note: this is a repository file count, not a live applied migration count.
countingDefinitions.uniqueTablesDefined: Set of distinct table names defined via CREATE TABLE across all 36 repository migration files.
countingDefinitions.uniqueViewsDefined: Set of distinct view names defined via CREATE [OR REPLACE] [MATERIALIZED] VIEW across all 36 repository migration files (robustly parsed to avoid "IF" false positives).
countingDefinitions.uniqueFunctionsDefined: Set of distinct stored functions defined via CREATE FUNCTION across all 36 repository migration files.
countingDefinitions.uniqueTriggersDefined: Set of distinct triggers defined via CREATE TRIGGER across all 36 repository migration files.
countingDefinitions.directSupabaseCallers: Files in apps/mobile importing or calling Supabase client directly.
countingDefinitions.railwayApiCallers: Files in apps/mobile referencing Fastify API gateway client or base URLs.
countingDefinitions.localFallbackFiles: Files in apps/mobile with mock IDs, placeholders, or silent fallback returns.
